title: IBS Works – Major Building & High-Rise Projects

date.notes: Portfolio record combining multiple IBS project sites completed during 2020. Individual floor/level breakdown is intentionally omitted from the public-facing summary.

summary: A portfolio of Indoor Building Solution (IBS) infrastructure works carried out during 2020 across major commercial, residential and institutional developments in Colombo, including ITC One, 606 The Address, Havelock City and the New OPD Building of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka. Across these projects, the work included IBS equipment installation, antenna, splitter and jumper installations, RF/coaxial cabling, cable laying and routing, conduit and support installation, rack-related works and associated indoor telecom infrastructure installation. The National Hospital New OPD project included building-wide IBS cabling and installation works, carried out in collaboration with SLT Mobitel and ATSL International (Pvt) Ltd.
